title: Mastering Business Central API for App Management
summary: This post provides practical PowerShell examples for automating extension management in Business Central using the Administration API, including deploying .app files, monitoring installation progress, handling failures, and uninstalling extensions.
key_points: Get a bearer token via the client credentials flow and reuse the header for every Administration API call

Install a .app through the pteInstall endpoint with a multipart form request carrying the file plus deploymentSchedule, syncMode, languageId, acceptIsvEula and dependency options; the upload is limited to 50 MB
Poll the app operations endpoint to track the deployment until it reports succeeded, failed or canceled, with failures returning an error message
Before uninstalling, call uninstallRequirements; then post to the uninstall endpoint with update window, dependents and delete-data settings and poll until done

quotes.text: To uninstall an extension, we first check whether any dependencies must be removed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Checking dependencies before uninstall prevents errors and ensures safe removal of extensions
